programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets the doha "Sarsuti Ke Bhandar" with today's situations in corporate life and says knowledge is a wealth that increases by sharing and it mutually adds to the teacher and the student.

programme.title: Burey Lagat
programme.desc: During a person's journey to success he usually tends to lose the people who are real and is flooded with only admirers. Javed Akhtar explains the reason behind this and how to overcome it.

programme.title: Sukh Sajjan
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says to understand the good in life one must experience the bad. One understands the value of love and relationships when it starts to part ways.

programme.title: Hoye Na Karaj
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says nobody is indispensable in this world. One must remember that work and everything else will continue to happen whether he/she contributes or not.

programme.desc: The common human problem of postponing one's tasks is very humorously explained by Javed Akhtar in this episode.

programme.title: Jaani Bujhi
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar explains the concept of having a conscience and deflecting from moral compass and running away from responsibilities is wrong. He says awareness is a burden if not implemented upon.

programme.title: Deh Dhare Ko
programme.desc: Some people think all problems happen to them but is it true or is it just a perspective? Javed Akhtar shares his thoughts on the same.

programme.title: Bhali Karat

programme.title: Kasht Parehu
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Kasht Parehu" where he says, no matter how many difficulties a good man has to face, he is never disappointed, just as how gold is heated several times to make it pure.

programme.title: Prerak Hi Te
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's Doha "Prerak Hi Te" where he says, an arrow is released only after the string of the bow is pulled back. Similarly, you may be determined to do something, but inspiration is a must.

programme.title: Kyo Kijai Aiso
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Kyo Kijai Aiso" that talks about putting efforts in the right direction. A benefit is reaped when there is a balance between 'what we want to do?' & 'how do we do it?'.

programme.title: Daan Dee
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Daan Dee" where he says, we sometimes donate only to better our social relationships; however, that should not be the case, we should donate to those who are in need.

programme.title: Sab Dekhai
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Sab Dekhai" where he says, people often point out mistakes of others but do not see their own, just like a lamp that provides light everywhere but not below itself.

programme.title: Nibale Jaani
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Nibale Jaani" where he says it is easy to blame others but what's difficult is to take the blame on oneself. He further says one should not put unwanted blame on others.
